User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the StudyShare Central platform.

friendRequestsReceived.description: An array of user IDs from whom this user has received a friend request.

pinnedSuggestions.description: An array of Suggestion IDs the user has pinned.

pinnedAssignments.description: An array of Assignment IDs the user has pinned.

participants.description: An array of user IDs participating in the chat.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

investments.description: An array of investment objects from users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Assignment entity.

semester.description: The semester the assignment is for.

fileUrl.description: URL of the uploaded file in Firebase Storage.

uploadDate.description: Date and time when the assignment was uploaded.

investments.description: An array of investment objects from users.

GameScore.title: Game Score
GameScore.description: Represents a score achieved by a user in a game.

userId.description: The ID of the user who achieved the score.

userName.description: The display name of the user.

userImage.description: The profile picture URL of the user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the score was achieved.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment on a suggestion or assignment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Comment entity.

userId.description: The ID of the user who posted the comment.

userName.description: The display name of the user.

userImage.description: The profile picture URL of the user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the comment was posted.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user, such as a mention.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

recipientId.description: The ID of the user who should receive the notification.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who triggered the notification.

senderName.description: The display name of the user who triggered the notification.

senderImage.description: The profile picture URL of the sender.

content.description: A short description of the notification content.

relatedLink.description: The URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked.

isRead.description: Whether the notification has been read by the user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the notification was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to address the 'auth/operation-not-allowed' error, ensure Authorization Independence, and facilitate secure and scalable data management for the StudyShare Central application. The error suggests an issue with Firebase Authentication configuration, which will be handled on the Firebase console configurations, as the JSON generation is for the Firestore structure only. The structure focuses on organizing user data, suggestions, and assignments in a way that simplifies security rules and optimizes query performance.

**Authorization Independence (Denormalization):**

*   The `userId` field is included in both `suggestions` and `assignments` collections. This denormalization allows security rules to validate ownership (`request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId`) without needing to perform expensive `get()` operations to retrieve user data.  This ensures that authorization checks are atomic and independent of other data.

**Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):**

*   User-specific data (suggestions, assignments) are stored under the `/users/{userId}` path.  This segregation ensures that all documents within a given user's subcollections share the same security requirements (i.e., only the user can create/modify/delete them).

**Access Modeling:**

*   **Private Data (User-Owned):**  Suggestions and assignments are placed under `/users/{userId}/suggestions` and `/users/{userId}/assignments` respectively, enforcing path-based ownership.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**

*   The segregation of data into user-specific subcollections enables secure `list` operations. Rules can easily restrict listing to only the data owned by the authenticated user.

**Invariants:**

*   The structure supports the integrity of ownership through the consistent use of `userId` in both `suggestions` and `assignments`.

In summary, this design prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by denormalizing authorization data, structurally segregating data based on access requirements, and enforcing consistent access patterns.
